# Project Lighthouse briefing
A tool that shows a customer's order history on one screen.

## Facts
- Launch is 12 March, first to the Dublin team [project_overview.md, meeting_notes.md]
- 22,000 of 40,000 EUR spent [project_overview.md]
- Order detail screen is done; search page and performance test are in progress [inventory.csv]

## Inferences
- Likely risk to the date: the slow old database may make searches exceed 5 seconds [project_overview.md]

## Open questions
- Who trains the support teams? Nobody is decided [meeting_notes.md; inventory.csv shows no owner]
- Will finance approve +5,000 EUR? [meeting_notes.md]
- User guide has no date [meeting_notes.md]

say:
The workspace describes Project Lighthouse, an order-history lookup tool launching 12 March.
Biggest risk: the old database may be too slow (searches over 5 seconds); training has no owner.
Briefing saved to output/briefing.md. A human must decide who runs training and whether the budget grows by 5,000 EUR.
